WhatsApp May Block Logins on Phones with Outdated Software

WhatsApp is reportedly planning to block logins on smartphones running outdated versions of iOS and Android software. The messaging service may implement this measure to enhance security and encourage users to update their devices and operating systems. Specific details regarding the timeline or the exact versions of software that will be affected have not yet been released.
